method_and_limits: Each repository-native adapter executes equivalent local assertions for the named fixture subset.
The adapters currently mirror the fixture assertions in code; they do not dynamically interpret the fixture prose at runtime.
No actual external service effect was dispatched; state transitions use local ledgers and synthetic decisions.
Passing local UNKNOWN state-machine tests does not prove authoritative reconciliation against an external provider.
M0 concurrency is tested with 16 simultaneous local workers; UWS is single-writer only.
The CI results establish the inspected branch commits and workflow scopes only, not production deployment or universal behavior.
